name: SurfaceUVProvider
signature: public delegate bool SurfaceUVProvider(int brushId, int sourceFaceIndex, in Plane facePlane, out SurfaceTexSpace space)

docs.summary: Supplies the texture projection for one brush surface, or returns false to leave that surface interpolating whatever UVs its source face carried.

params.brushId: Brush the surface belongs to, matching [`Id`](#api~Prowl.Vector.Geometry.CSGBrushHandle~Id).
params.sourceFaceIndex: Index of the face in that brush's shape.
params.space: Receives the texture projection when true is returned.
